verdict.rationale: Ledgy's financial reporting page says it can instantly generate financial reports that account for equity under US GAAP (as well as IFRS 2 and UK GAAP), with tranche-level detail. It also offers configurable reporting settings with custom overrides and aggregate grouping, plus one-click compliance reports and exports, which covers the core of producing stock-based compensation expense reports for accountants. missing for 10: explicit naming of ASC 718 expense reports, evidence that outputs are audit-ready (e.g., audit trails or auditor-facing documentation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
